EmailTemplate.subject: Request for Housing License Agreement Release
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!TODAY()}
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
This is an official response to your request for release from the University Housing License Agreement for 2015-2016 academic year.
Upon careful review of your request, you have been denied release from the University Housing License Agreement for the following reason(s):
__ The required supporting documentation did not meet the criteria stated for release from the License Agreement, or the required supporting documentation was insufficient to justify release from the License Agreement.
__ An alternative living arrangement on campus should be pursued by contacting your Residence Hall Staff. They can assist you with a room or hall change that will better meet your needs.
__ The reason stated on your petition for release did not meet the criteria for release as outlined in the License Agreement terms and conditions.
__ The reason stated on your petition for release could not be verified. This applies to requests for release on the basis of: graduation, withdrawal from ASU, transfer from ASU, military duty activation, or academic internship.
__ The deadline for submission has passed.
Because your request has been denied, you are still responsible for your assignment to your residence hall for the 2015-2016 academic year. In addition, you are responsible for all applicable room, meal plan, lock change and damage charges associated with that assignment.
If you require further information, please refer to the University Housing License Agreement or contact our office at (480) 965-3515.
Sincerely,
{!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName} University Housing Arizona State University
